_comment: Presentation-only settings for ciders, keyed by VinoShipper product id. All content (name, description, tasting notes, ABV, price, image, inventory, awards, packs, ship-to states) is read live from VinoShipper; edit those there. A cider not listed here still shows up, using `defaults`. `image` overrides VinoShipper's label art with one of our transparent bottle renders (public/images/shop/cider/trans-*.png). `featured` picks the homepage's 'Now pouring' cider (first match wins). `swatch` is the color bar on the card.
